name: level-shifter-oxide-safety-postlayout
description: POST-LAYOUT re-run of sim/level-shifter-oxide-safety/ (spec/gate-driver.md sec4 cascode/clamped level shifter; sec2.3 thin-oxide gate ceiling; decision records 0003/0014/0015): the same transient thin-oxide gate-to-any-node excursion, functional correctness and propagation delay measurements, ported to the flat, hierarchy-prefixed node names the extracted whole-block DUT (layout/lvs/gate_driver_core.extracted.spice / .extracted-rc.spice) uses -- the level shifter has no independent top-cell boundary in layout/gate_driver_core.gds, so this is the same DUT sim/gate-driver-core-drive-with-uvlo-postlayout/ runs against, with the output stage, uvlo and the 1 nF reference load present so the level shifter sees its real post-layout load on IN_DRV. See testbench/*.spice header for the full node-name mapping and the XCCOMP-node reproducibility note.
analyses: meas tran t_plh trig v(IN) val=1.65 rise=1 targ v(IN_DRV) val=2.5 rise=1
meas tran t_phl trig v(IN) val=1.65 fall=1 targ v(IN_DRV) val=2.5 fall=1
meas tran vout_hi_abs find v(IN_DRV) at=59n
meas tran vout_lo_abs find v(IN_DRV) at=19n
meas tran vdrv_now find v(VDD_DRV) at=59n

vgate_thinox_max.description: spec sec2.3: no thin-oxide gate-to-any-node DC/transient excursion may exceed 3.63V, at any instant, any corner -- the sec4 topology's central claim. Ported unchanged from sim/level-shifter-oxide-safety/ -- decision record 0003/0015's ratified Exception 1 band bounds inb's overshoot at the vlogic3p63v corner (<=3.670V) separately from this uniform check; see this facet's own record narrative for the Exception 1 comparison.

vout_hi_ratio.description: IN held high (t=59ns, mid-pulse) -> IN_DRV (the level shifter's own output, block-internal net feeding output_stage) must track VDD_DRV (non-inverting, decision record 0001 Decision 3).

vout_lo_ratio.description: IN held low (t=19ns, pre-edge) -> IN_DRV must sit near GND_DRV (non-inverting, off state).

vccomp_dev_max.description: decision record 0014: worst-case transient voltage across ANY ONE of the four extracted XCCOMP MiM series-stack legs (x1_ncb-ANON293, ANON293-ANON294, ANON294-ANON295, ANON295-IN_DRV), against the gf180mcu MiM capacitor's 6V rating -- ported unchanged from sim/level-shifter-oxide-safety/, see testbench/*.spice header for why these ANON<N> nodes are real and reproducible, not dropped.
